name: Jeremih
notes: Chronologically the lane's earliest mainstream exemplar, deliberately windowed at 2013 because "his 2009–2012 era belongs to `rnb-2000s`' idiom and is excluded here". The one drum fact the entry singles out is authored as the model's loudest feature: "a distinctive offbeat 808-maraca or shaker on the 'and' of every beat that is one of the era's fingerprints" — a `shaker` perc lane at `placement` `offbeat` with a density of four per bar. The rest of the kit is the entry's: clap on 3, kick on 1 and the 16th before 3, dense swung 16ths with triplet rolls, snare rolls and reversed cymbals as risers. "The 808 rests on beat 3 so the clap has room" is `muteUnderSnare`. The vocal claim is the melody block: "high falsetto used as the primary register, thin and airy… very high stacked-harmony count… and low lead note-density", so the lead register starts above the break, `densityPerBar` is low and `countermelody.densityRatio` is high — the stack is an instrumental layer, which is what the counter models here. ⚠ The **INFERRED** parameters are the swing amount, all drum probabilities and densities, the 808 slide numbers and the chord extension spread; the entry names "m9 pads" and "2-chord loops" and no figures. ⚠ `confidence` is medium, mirroring the entry. ⚠ `session.bpm.mode` is **INFERRED**: the number is not stated in the entry, and it is an authored centre of gravity inside the band the entry does state. ⚠ **`session.keys` is INFERRED.** The entry's Keys line describes the harmonic grammar but names no key centre, so these values and their weights are an authored choice — no key in this set is stated in the research. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 977/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980 (2026-08-17, counter variety floor).** `melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.16 to 0.1. The counter's note count is `densityRatio` times the lead's own note count, so a bar the lead leaves empty is a bar the counter has nothing to answer — and one empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one, which is the single thing a seed cannot vary. Measured across this roster the models failing this gate average 0.150 here against 0.030 for the models that pass. ⚠ The value that moved here is INFERRED rather than a researched claim — the entry's Melody/chords line reads "bell, marimba and pluck riffs over dark pads; 2-bar loops. Melody is high falsetto used as the primary register, thin and airy, with a very high stacked-harmony count (his signature is dense self-harmonised pads used as an instrumental layer) and low lead note-density. Whispered and spoken interjections.", and every claim in it still holds after the change.
